newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 52-wk bills rate seen between 5.25/5.26 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 52-wk bills rate seen between 5.25/5.26 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $13.0 billion in 52-week bills on Thursday was expected to garner a discount rate between 5.25 and 5.26 percent, market participants said.
In when-issued trade at about 1245 EDT/1645 GMT, the 52-week bill was quoted at 5.255. Dealers said they expected decent demand.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
